tools.name: get_latest_filings
tools.description: Return the most recent SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) with AI analysis and 30-day alpha predictions. Optionally filter by ticker and/or form type.

tools.name: get_filing_analysis
tools.description: Return the full AI analysis for a single SEC filing by accession number: executive summary, concern level, sentiment, EPS surprise, predicted 30-day alpha, and (if available) the realized outcome.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Return a company snapshot (financials, valuation, analyst data) and its most recent analyzed SEC filings by ticker.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search tracked companies by ticker or name. Returns matching tickers with company names and sectors.

tools.name: screen_companies
tools.description: Filter the tracked-company universe (800+ US companies, all S&P 500 constituents) by fundamentals: sector, minimum market cap, maximum P/E, minimum dividend yield, and minimum revenue growth. Mirrors the /screener tool. Returns matching companies with links to their pages.

tools.name: get_top_signals
tools.description: Return the highest-conviction filing predictions from the last 90 days, ranked by |predicted 30-day alpha| weighted by confidence. These are the model's strongest current directional calls.

tools.name: get_model_track_record
tools.description: Return the model's validated track record from strict 90-day walk-forward cross-validation, plus a live count of filings in the database that already have a realized 30-day outcome available for evaluation.
